concept: Modeling healthy physical habits for children or those you influence, through action more than instruction
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic family scenario where a child's relationship with movement and health is being shaped by what they see the adult actually do
exercise.reflection_prompt: What is your own behavior teaching, regardless of what you say?
exercise.practice: Adult identifies one specific, shared physical activity to do together

assessment.success_marker: adult names a specific shared activity, not just a resolution to 'set a good example'
